purpose: The Card Token Vault enables payment services to securely handle card numbers by replacing them with tokens, allowing for secure transactions without storing sensitive card data.

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: vault-db (PostgreSQL) is the main datastore of the vault and runs as a primary with a standby in a second availability zone.
